# POST /api/v1/workspaces/:ws/runs: start a run from content, plus refs and new statuses in the UI ## What to build An API client with a `runs:start` token can start a graph-execution run from free markdown. `POST /api/v1/workspaces/:ws/runs` validates the body, writes the content (and refs) to `/inputs//`, starts the engine with `graph-execution --content [--refs ] [--no-plan-gate] --provider

… --web` exactly as the cookie Start run does (local detached process, or a sandbox container), records the run in a new store registry `apiRuns`, and answers `201 {runId, viewUrl}`. A repeated `idempotencyKey` in the same workspace answers `200` with the first run's run object instead of starting a new run. **Decision (sandbox inputs):** `` is never mounted in a sandbox container, and graph-manager's sandbox paths only accept `--content`/`--refs` files inside the workspace. So for a sandboxed start the inputs are also copied into the workspace at `/.graph-execution//inputs/` (the run's own folder, which is already ignored by git and is where `sandbox.ts` puts the reviewers copy `.sandbox-reviewers.json` before the container starts) and the engine gets that workspace-relative path. The canonical copy stays in `/inputs//`. No extra mount. The start code of the existing `POST /api/runs/:ws` (`src/server/routes/runs.ts` lines 112–156) is **factored into a shared function** that both routes call (no copy). The web UI shows what the engine's plan stage adds: the three new run statuses get status chips, runs with refs show them as links (`KAN-41 ↗`) on the Runs list row and on the run detail, and a `needs-info` run shows its questions on the run detail. ### What is already in the code (dependencies) - **Engine** (`graph-execution`): `graph-execution --content [--refs ] [--no-plan-gate] --provider X` starts a run that first plans (status `planning`), then ends `needs-info`, stops at `awaiting-approval` (gate on, the default) or goes on to `running`. It works with `--web`, `--sandbox`, `--model` and every run option, and with `GRAPH_EXECUTION_HANDOFF=detached` (the launcher prints `Started run in the background…` and exits 0). `--content` with a tasks dir or `--spec` is a usage error. `--refs` is a JSON array `[{ref, url?, title?}]`. The fake provider (`--provider fake`) has a planner mode: it writes a one-task spec and tasks. The process exits with `EXIT_NEEDS_INFO` (4) at `needs-info` and `EXIT_AWAITING_APPROVAL` (5) at `awaiting-approval` (the detached launcher still exits 0 at start). The engine copies the content into `/plan/content.md`. `runStatusSchema` has `planning | needs-info | awaiting-approval` and `stateSchema.plan` is `{ contentPath, refs: [{ref,url?,title?}], gate, name?, attempts, questions: [{ref?, questions: string[]}], dropped: string[], feedback: string[] }`; `specPath`/`tasksDir`/`hashes` are optional while planning. - **Tokens** (`src/server/tokens.ts`, `src/server/auth.ts`): `requireScope(scope)` preHandler (403 `missing scope `), `apiAuthOf(req)` → `{ kind: "admin" } | { kind: "token", id, scopes }`. Bearer and cookie both work on `/api/v1/*`. Tests create tokens with `POST /api/tokens {name, scopes}` (cookie) → `{token}`. - **v1 reads** (`src/server/v1-runs.ts`, `src/server/routes/v1.ts`): `findRun(ctx, runId)` → `{ ws, runId, summary, state? } | undefined`, `toRunObject(ctx, found)` → the run object `{ runId, workspace, status, refs, questions, dropped, spec?, tasksDir?, viewUrl, pr?, error?, createdAt?, updatedAt? }`; `detailUrlOf(wsId, runId)` = `/runs//` in `src/server/runs.ts` (v1's `viewUrl`). `toRunObject` reads refs from `state.plan.refs`. `v1Routes(app, ctx)` in `src/server/routes/v1.ts` holds `GET /api/v1/ping`, `GET /api/v1/runs`, `GET /api/v1/runs/:id`, `GET /api/v1/workspaces`. ## Context: files to read before implementing - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/runs.ts` (whole file, 164 lines) — `PROVIDERS` (15), `startBody` (17–24), `newRunId` (32–36), `engineCommand` (49–51), `lastLines` (53), `rememberSandbox` (56–60), the POST handler (86–157): sandbox branch (112–127, `ctx.sandboxes.start({ ws, cwd: ws.path, args: sbArgs, runId, providers: [provider] })`, `SandboxError` → `reply.code(err.status)`), local branch (129–156: env with `GRAPH_EXECUTION_HANDOFF: "detached"`, `SSH_CONNECTION: "1"`, `RUN_ID_ENV`, `REVIEWERS_ENV`, `INTERNAL_ENV` removed, `GM_PASSWORD` removed; `execa(..., { timeout: START_TIMEOUT_MS })`; non-zero exit → `400 {error: tail, exitCode, output: tail}`; the printed run id regex at 152). - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runoptions.ts` (whole file, 63 lines) — `runOptionsSchema`, `optionArgs`, `RESERVED_FLAGS` (37), `splitExtraArgs`, `startArgs` (60–63). - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/sandbox.ts` (lines 96–108 `StartParams`; 586–597 how the reviewers copy is written into the run folder with `mkdir` + `chown` to the workspace owner, because `` is never mounted in a sandbox and the workspace is, at the same path; 499 `start`). - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/sandbox-paths.ts` (lines 1–12 `VALUE_OPTIONS` / `PATH_OPTIONS`; 45–75 `toContainerArgs`, which maps path options for a Windows host). - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/store.ts` (10–85) — add `apiRuns`. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/runs.test.ts` (lines 1–84 setup with the real built engine: `defaultGraphExecutionBin()`, `it.skipIf(!built)`, `poll`, killing started pids in `afterEach`) and `routes/runs.sandbox.test.ts` (lines 1–113: fake Docker, `vi.spyOn(Sandboxes.prototype, "prepareTools" | "buildImages")`, inspecting `fake.containers` and `ct.Config.Cmd`). - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runs.ts` (21–44 `RunSummary`, 243–277 `summarize`) — add `refs`, `questions`, `dropped` to the summary for the UI. - Web: `apps/graph-manager/src/web/types.ts` (4–24 `RunSummary`), `src/web/ui/status.ts` (9–17 `RUN` map) + `status.test.ts`, `src/web/pages/Runs.tsx` (142–206 `RunRow`: the run id cell 174–179), `src/web/pages/RunDetail.tsx` (284 `canResume`, 292–360 the header and `run-meta`), `src/web/pages/Runs.test.tsx` (1–70 the `run()` factory and fetch stub), `src/web/pages/RunDetail.test.tsx`. ## Patterns to follow **Shared start (new `src/server/start-run.ts`), moved from routes/runs.ts 112–156:** ```ts /** A start that failed: the HTTP status and the JSON body to answer with. */ export class StartError extends Error { constructor(readonly status: number, message: string, readonly extra: { exitCode?: number; output?: string } = {}) { super(message); } } /** * Starts graph-execution in the workspace with `args` (ending in "--web"): in a new sandbox container (without * "--web") or as a detached local process. Returns the run id the engine reports (else `runId`). Throws StartError. */ export async function startEngine(ctx: AppContext, ws: Workspace, p: { runId: string; args: string[]; provider: string; sandbox: boolean }): Promise ``` The cookie route becomes: build args → `try { id = await startEngine(...) } catch (err) { if (err instanceof StartError) return reply.code(err.status).send({ error: err.message, ...err.extra }); throw err; }` → `rememberSandbox` + `saveDefaults` (unchanged, cookie route only) → `201 { runId: id, viewUrl: viewUrlOf(ws.id, id) }`. Keep its exact responses (the existing `runs.test.ts` and `runs.sandbox.test.ts` must pass unchanged; `exitCode`/`output` keys only when set). **Body validation:** `schema.parse(req.body ?? {})`; a `ZodError` becomes `400 {"error":": "}` in app.ts's error handler. **Store record (mirror `prs` in store.ts 20–25):** ```ts /** Runs started through /api/v1 (docs/prd/automation-api.md). Key: `${workspaceId}/${runId}`. */ apiRuns: z .record(z.string(), z.object({ refs: z.array(z.object({ ref: z.string(), url: z.string().optional(), title: z.string().optional() })).default([]), openPr: z.boolean().default(false), idempotencyKey: z.string().optional(), /** The token id, or "admin" for a cookie session. */ startedBy: z.string(), createdAt: z.string(), })) .default({}), ``` ## Step-by-step tasks ### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/start-run.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: `StartError`, `startEngine` (move the body of routes/runs.ts 112–156 here: sandbox branch → `ctx.sandboxes.start({ ws, cwd: ws.path, args: args.filter((a) => a !== "--web"), runId, providers: [provider] })`, `SandboxError` → `StartError(err.status, err.message, err.output ? { output: lastLines(err.output, 20) } : {})`, `!ctx.sandboxes` → `StartError(400, "sandboxes are not set up")`; local branch unchanged incl. the printed-id regex). Move `START_TIMEOUT_MS`, `INTERNAL_ENV`, `engineCommand`, `lastLines` here too and re-export them from routes/runs.ts (`export { engineCommand, … } from "../start-run.js"`) because `routes/resume.ts` (line 13) and tests import them from `./runs.js`. - **GOTCHA**: avoid an import cycle: start-run.ts imports from `./sandbox-run.js`, `./reviewers.js`, `./runs.js` (`isRunId`), never from `./routes/*`. - **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/routes/runs.test.ts src/server/routes/runs.sandbox.test.ts` ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/runs.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: the POST handler calls `startEngine` as in the pattern. Nothing else changes. ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runoptions.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: add `"--content", "--refs", "--no-plan-gate", "--approve-plan", "--replan"` to `RESERVED_FLAGS`, and ```ts /** The graph-execution argv for a start from content (POST /api/v1/workspaces/:ws/runs). */ export function contentArgs(b: { content: string; refs?: string; gate: "approve" | "auto"; provider: string; options?: RunOptionsBody }): string[] { const o = b.options ?? {}; return ["--content", b.content, ...(b.refs ? ["--refs", b.refs] : []), ...(b.gate === "auto" ? ["--no-plan-gate"] : []), "--provider", b.provider, ...optionArgs(o), ...splitExtraArgs(o.extraArgs), "--web"]; } ``` - **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/runoptions.test.ts` (add a `contentArgs` case there). ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/sandbox-paths.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: `PATH_OPTIONS` (line 10) gets `"--content"`, `"--refs"`, `"--replan"` so a Windows host maps them like `--spec`. Add a case to `sandbox-paths.test.ts`. ### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/inputs.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: ```ts /** `/inputs/`: what an API client sent for a run (content, refs, reject feedback). */ export const inputsDirOf = (dataDir: string, runId: string): string => path.join(dataDir, "inputs", runId); /** * Writes the files (mode 600) to `/inputs//`. A sandboxed run can't see the data dir (only the * workspace is mounted, at the same path), so for one they are also copied into `/.graph-execution//inputs/`, * owned by the workspace's owner (as sandbox.ts does for the reviewers copy). Returns, per file name, the path to * pass to the engine: the data-dir path, or for a sandbox the workspace-relative path with "/" separators. */ export async function writeRunInputs(ctx: AppContext, ws: Workspace, runId: string, files: { name: string; text: string }[], sandboxed: boolean): Promise> ``` For the copy: `mkdir(dir, { recursive: true })`, `writeFile(file, text, { mode: 0o600 })`, then on non-Windows `const st = await stat(ws.path); await chown(x, st.uid, st.gid).catch(() => undefined)` for the created folders and files. Relative path: `[RUNS_DIR, runId, "inputs", name].join("/")` (`RUNS_DIR` from `graph-execution/api`, i.e. `.graph-execution`; the engine runs with cwd = `ws.path`). - **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck -w graph-manager` ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/store.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: the `apiRuns` key (snippet above), `export type ApiRunRecord = Data["apiRuns"][string]`. ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/v1.ts` - **IMPLEMENT** `POST /api/v1/workspaces/:ws/runs` with `{ preHandler: requireScope("runs:start") }`: 1. `const ws = resolveWorkspace(ctx.config.workspacesDir, req.params.ws)`; missing or `!existsSync(ws.path)` → `404 {"error":"unknown workspace"}`. 2. Body: ```ts const refSchema = z.object({ ref: z.string().trim().min(1).max(200), url: z.string().max(2000).regex(/^https?:\/\//i, "must be an http(s) URL").optional(), title: z.string().max(500).optional(), }); const startFromContent = z.object({ content: z.string().min(1, "content is required").max(200_000, "content is longer than 200000 characters"), refs: z.array(refSchema).max(200).optional(), provider: z.enum(PROVIDERS).optional(), model: runOptionsSchema.shape.model, gate: z.enum(["approve", "auto"]).default("approve"), sandbox: z.boolean().default(true), openPr: z.boolean().default(false), idempotencyKey: z.string().min(1).max(200).optional(), options: runOptionsSchema.optional(), }); ``` Duplicate `ref` values → `400 {"error":"refs: duplicate ref "}`. 3. Idempotency: if `idempotencyKey` is set and an `apiRuns` entry whose key starts with `/` has the same `idempotencyKey`: `findRun(ctx, runId)`; found → `200` with `toRunObject(...)`. (If the run folder is gone, start a new run.) Two requests with the same key at the same time: keep a module-level `Map<"/", Promise<…>>` of in-flight starts; the second awaits the first and answers 200 with its run object. 4. Provider: `body.provider ?? ctx.store.get().runDefaults[ws.id]?.provider`; none, or a saved one not in `PROVIDERS` → `400 {"error":"no provider: pass provider or start a run in this workspace once"}` (exact text). 5. `options = { ...body.options, ...(body.model ? { model: body.model } : {}) }`; `runId = newRunId()`. 6. `paths = await writeRunInputs(ctx, ws, runId, [{ name: "content.md", text: body.content }, ...(refs.length ? [{ name: "refs.json", text: JSON.stringify(refs, null, 2) }] : [])], body.sandbox)`. 7. `args = contentArgs({ content: paths["content.md"], refs: paths["refs.json"], gate, provider, options })` — `ExtraArgsError` → 400 with its message (as routes/runs.ts 101–104). 8. `id = await startEngine(ctx, ws, { runId, args, provider, sandbox: body.sandbox })`; `StartError` → `reply.code(err.status).send({ error, ...extra })`. 9. `await ctx.store.update((d) => { d.apiRuns[ws.id + "/" + id] = { refs, openPr, idempotencyKey, startedBy, createdAt: new Date().toISOString() }; })` with `startedBy = auth?.kind === "token" ? auth.id : "admin"` from `apiAuthOf(req)`. 10. `201 { runId: id, viewUrl: detailUrlOf(ws.id, id) }`. - **GOTCHA**: do NOT write `runDefaults` or `workspaceSettings[ws].sandbox` for API starts (a content run has no tasksDir/spec, and the UI's remembered choices stay the human's). - **GOTCHA**: `sandbox` defaults to `true`. Tests must pass `sandbox: false`, or use the fake Docker from `runs.sandbox.test.ts`; never let a test reach a real Docker socket. - **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/routes/v1.start.test.ts` ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/v1-runs.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: `toRunObject` reads refs from `ctx.store.get().apiRuns[key]?.refs` first (when non-empty), then `state.plan?.refs`, then `[]`. ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runs.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: `RunSummary` gets `refs?: { ref: string; url?: string; title?: string }[]`, `questions?: { ref?: string; questions: string[] }[]`, `dropped?: string[]`; `summarize` sets them from `s.plan` when present and non-empty. ### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/v1.start.test.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: - Without the engine (`appWithLogin()`, workspace `github~octo~hello` made with `git init` under `config.workspacesDir`, a `runs:start runs:read` token): - unknown workspace → 404; `{}` → 400; `content` of 200 001 chars → 400; `refs: [{ref:"A"},{ref:"A"}]` → 400; `refs: [{ref:"A", url:"javascript:x"}]` → 400; `gate: "x"` → 400. - no `provider` and no `runDefaults` → 400 `{"error":"no provider: pass provider or start a run in this workspace once"}`. - a token with only `runs:read` → 403 `missing scope runs:start`. - idempotency: seed `store.update((d) => { d.apiRuns["github~octo~hello/gm-20260101-000000-abcd"] = { refs: [], openPr: false, idempotencyKey: "k1", startedBy: "admin", createdAt: "x" }; })` and write that run's `state.json` (`stateSchema.parse`, status `awaiting-approval`, a `plan`), then POST with `idempotencyKey: "k1"` → 200 and `runId` is `gm-20260101-000000-abcd`; the same key in another workspace is not matched. - With the built engine (`it.skipIf(!built)`, mirror `routes/runs.test.ts` 1–84: `buildApp(testConfig(dir, { graphExecutionBin: BIN }), …)`, `app.listen`, real `fetch`, a committed repo): POST `{ content: "# Add hello\n\nWrite hello.txt\n", refs: [{ref:"A",url:"https://t/A"}], provider: "fake", sandbox: false, idempotencyKey: "k2" }` with a bearer → 201 `{runId, viewUrl: "/runs/github~octo~hello/"}`; `/inputs//content.md` and `refs.json` exist with the sent text; `store.get().apiRuns` has the key with `startedBy` = the token id; poll `GET /api/v1/runs/` until `status` is `awaiting-approval` (allow `planning` before it), then check `refs` and `spec` (`docs/prd/.md`). A second POST with `idempotencyKey: "k2"` → 200 with the same `runId`. Kill any `web.json` pid left in `afterEach` as runs.test.ts does. - Sandboxed (mirror `routes/runs.sandbox.test.ts` setup with the fake Docker; `appWithLogin({ dockerSocket: fake.socketPath, sandboxImage: "img:default" })`): POST without `sandbox` (default true) and `provider: "fake"` → 201; the container `Cmd` contains `--content` followed by `.graph-execution//inputs/content.md` (on a non-Windows host unchanged by `toContainerArgs`) and not `--web`; that file exists in the workspace with the content. - **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/routes/v1.start.test.ts` ### UPDATE web: `src/web/types.ts`, `src/web/ui/status.ts`, `src/web/pages/Runs.tsx`, `src/web/pages/RunDetail.tsx` - **IMPLEMENT**: - `types.ts` `RunSummary`: `refs?`, `questions?`, `dropped?` (same shapes as the server). - `status.ts` `RUN`: `planning: ["live", "pulse"]`, `"needs-info": ["warn", "dashed"]`, `"awaiting-approval": ["rev", "half"]`; add the three rows to `status.test.ts`'s table. - New `src/web/ui/RefLinks.tsx`: `export function RefLinks({ refs }: { refs?: RunSummary["refs"] })` → nothing for none; else a `` with, per ref, ` e.stopPropagation()}>{ref} ↗` when `url` is an `http(s)` URL, else `{ref}`. Style in `ui/base.css` (small, muted, gap 6px). - `Runs.tsx` `RunRow`: render `` in the run cell after the id / LiveDot (lines 174–179). - `RunDetail.tsx`: `` in `run-meta` (after the provider); when `summary.status === "needs-info"` and `summary.questions?.length`, a panel `data-testid="run-questions"` above the body: heading "Needs more information", then per entry the ref (or "Content" when no ref) and its questions as a list, and when `summary.dropped?.length` a line "Dropped: A, B". `canResume` (line 284) must be false for `planning`, `needs-info` and `awaiting-approval` (the engine refuses a plain resume of an awaiting-approval run; approval comes from the Approvals page). - **PATTERN**: `src/web/ui/StatusBadge.tsx`, the existing `runs-pr-link` anchor in `Runs.tsx` 116–121 (stopPropagation on row clicks). - **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- src/web/ui/status.test.ts src/web/pages/Runs.test.tsx src/web/pages/RunDetail.test.tsx` ### UPDATE web tests - **IMPLEMENT**: in `Runs.test.tsx`, a run with `refs: [{ref:"A",url:"https://t/A"},{ref:"B"}]` shows a link named `A ↗` with `href="https://t/A"` and `target="_blank"`, and plain text `B`; clicking the link does not navigate to the run (row click). In `RunDetail.test.tsx`, a `needs-info` run with questions shows `run-questions` with the question text and no Resume button; an `awaiting-approval` run shows the `awaiting-approval` badge and no Resume button. ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] `POST /api/v1/workspaces/:ws/runs {content, sandbox:false, provider:"fake"}` with a `runs:start` token → `201 {runId, viewUrl}`; `GET /api/v1/runs/:id` then shows `planning` and later `awaiting-approval`. - [ ] Content and refs are written to `/inputs//content.md` and `refs.json`; a sandboxed start also gets the copy in `/.graph-execution//inputs/` and passes that path. - [ ] Same `idempotencyKey` in the same workspace → `200` with the same `runId`. - [ ] No provider and no saved default → `400 {"error":"no provider: pass provider or start a run in this workspace once"}`; bad body → 400; unknown workspace → 404; missing scope → 403. - [ ] `apiRuns["/"]` = `{ refs, openPr, idempotencyKey?, startedBy, createdAt }`. - [ ] The cookie `POST /api/runs/:ws` behaves exactly as before (its tests pass unchanged) and shares `startEngine`. - [ ] Runs list rows and run detail show refs as `A ↗` links; the three new statuses have chips; `needs-info` shows the questions; no Resume button on the new statuses. - [ ] Tests pass: `npm test -w graph-manager` ## Validation commands ```bash npm run build -w graph-execution # the start tests use the built engine (they skip without it) npm run typecheck && npm run lint npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/routes/v1.start.test.ts src/server/routes/runs.test.ts src/server/routes/runs.sandbox.test.ts src/server/runoptions.test.ts src/server/sandbox-paths.test.ts npm test -w graph-manager -- src/web/ui/status.test.ts src/web/pages/Runs.test.tsx src/web/pages/RunDetail.test.tsx npm test -w graph-manager ``` The UI changed: start graph-manager as TESTING.md "## graph-manager" describes, start a run through `curl -H "authorization: Bearer " -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"content":"# Add hello\nWrite hello.txt","refs":[{"ref":"A","url":"https://example.com/A"}],"provider":"fake","sandbox":false}' http://127.0.0.1:7420/api/v1/workspaces//runs`, and look at the Runs list and the run detail in agent-browser (refs link, `awaiting-approval` chip).
